pillars.title: Play and experimentation
pillars.description: A space open to mistakes, where performers feel free to try, to fail, and to discover. Play within the group is the foundation of every session.

pillars.title: Warmth and presence
pillars.description: Teaching that is close, smiling, and firm when necessary. No walls between teacher and student -- just shared commitment to the work.

pillars.title: Physical discipline meets imagination
pillars.description: Rigorous physical training blended with creative exploration, guiding performers toward authenticity, expressivity, and a living theatrical presence.

process.title: Enter through the body
process.description: Every session begins with physical preparation -- breath, rhythm, and awareness. The body becomes the instrument before the mask or the character arrives.

process.title: Play within the ensemble
process.description: Work happens in the group. Performers discover characters, impulses, and dynamics through collective play, improvisation, and the generous exchange of energy.

process.title: Carry it forward
process.description: Each workshop closes with reflection and integration. What was discovered in the room becomes a tool for the stage, the rehearsal, and life itself.
